title: LoadCatalog
description: Published handloading records, schemaVersion 1.0.0. One file per source. Do not add, remove, rename, or retype a field without bumping schemaVersion and calling the change out. Values are copied as published. Unknown values are null. Do not convert units or invent charges.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog contract version. Application code should reject other versions.

generatedOn.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the file was generated. Null if unknown.

source.description: The publication this file was read from. Not the upstream manual unless that manual is what was read.

name.description: Publisher name as cited, for example LoadDevelopment.com.

retrievedOn.description: ISO date this source was read.

testBarrelIn.description: One test-barrel length in inches when the source states a single barrel in inches. Null when it does not. Do not convert from another unit.

cartridge.description: Cartridge name exactly as published. The app keeps its own alias map.

bulletDiameterIn.description: Bullet diameter in inches as published. Null when the source does not print a diameter. Do not derive it from the cartridge name.

bulletWeightGr.description: Bullet weight in grains as published. Required. A row with no published weight is omitted rather than stored as 0.

bulletDescription.description: Bullet brand, line, and type as published. Null when the source does not describe the bullet.

bulletManufacturer.description: Bullet maker as published, including abbreviations. Null when unpublished. Not rewritten to a bullet-library name.

bulletSku.description: Bullet part number as published. Null when unpublished. Together with bulletManufacturer this is the link to the bullet library id {manufacturer}-{sku}.

powder.description: Powder name as published. Null when unpublished.

charge.description: One charge weight in the source unit. A published min and max are two records, not a range. Null when unpublished.

chargeUnit.description: Unit the source used for charge. Null when charge is null.

chargeLevel.description: How the source labeled this charge. Null when unlabeled.

compressed.description: True or false when the source marks the charge compressed or not. Null when the source does not say.

primer.description: Primer as published. Null when unpublished.

case.description: Case brand or description as published. Null when unpublished.

coal.description: Cartridge overall length in the source unit. Null when unpublished. A separate maximum OAL, when printed, stays in notes.

coalUnit.description: Unit the source used for coal. Null when coal is null.

barrelLength.description: Barrel length in the source unit. Null when unknown.

barrelLengthUnit.description: Unit the source used for barrelLength. Null when barrelLength is null.

barrelLengthOrigin.description: row when this length was printed on the load. source_default when it was taken from the source's stated test barrel. Null when no length is recorded.

velocity.description: Velocity in the source unit for this charge. Null when unpublished.

velocityUnit.description: Unit the source used for velocity. Null when velocity is null.

pressure.description: Pressure in the source unit. Null when unpublished. Never a mix of PSI and CUP.

pressureUnit.description: Unit the source used for pressure. Null when pressure is null. Do not convert between these.

pressureMethod.description: How the source said pressure was measured. Null when no pressure is published. unknown only when a pressure number is published and the method is not identified.

sourceUrl.description: Page or PDF URL this load was read from.

sourcePage.description: Page or table reference inside a manual, as published. Null when the source has none.

notes.description: Source text that has no field of its own, plus a short parsing note when a value was split or labeled. Null when there is nothing to add.
